recent.name: 5 GHz on the X28 PRO unit with the two-chip capability keys (applied to the Wi-Fi templates by hand on the unit)
recent.result: ✅ after a reboot `rai0` is on channel 36, the chip reports 64 °C and there are no `FWCmdTimeout` lines (before: temperature 0, 20 timeouts over 30 s, a coredump); the vendor firmware on slot B uses the same keys

recent.name: DHCP at boot on the X28 PRO unit with `x28-dhcp` (installed by hand on the unit)
recent.result: ✅ the guard restarted `dnsmasq` 25 s after boot (`x28-dhcp: dnsmasq has no DHCP range for lan; restarting it (1 of 3)`) and the range was served at 34 s, with no manual bridge restart; before it, DHCP stayed dead until the bridge was restarted

recent.name: Boot slot switched to B on the X28 PRO unit: the two priority bytes swapped in the four `misc` copies with `dd-nand`
recent.result: ✅ written and read back, 8 bytes of the 1 MiB differ; the unit then booted slot B (vendor firmware, key-only SSH on 2222 answered). A USB block write to `misc` was refused again (first block not acknowledged, agent silent afterwards)
